text: F-111 x F-234: a feature PR cannot add a CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry without cutting a release. F-111 (test/release.test.mjs:556) requires package.json past the latest release once [Unreleased] holds entries; F-234 (test/release.test.mjs:657) requires both tutorials to name package.json's version, the sakk-<version>.tgz and the --version output, i.e. a re-recorded tutorial run. Before F-234 a feature PR only bumped the version (87eb25f, 0.1.0 to 0.2.0). Hit by feat/gateway-ops on 2026-11-02 (1418/1419 pass, only F-111 red); feat/gateway-entry and feat/gateway-fail-open carry [Unreleased] entries at 0.3.0 too. Possible fixes for the owner: F-234 compares the tutorials with the latest released heading in CHANGELOG.md instead of package.json, or one PR bumps the version and re-records the tutorials for the batch.
reason: Owner ruling 2026-11-01 (follow the recommendation): the first merged PR, feat/gateway-ops, bumps to 0.4.0 and re-runs both tutorials on the packed 0.4.0 tarball, so F-111 and F-234 both hold with no gate changed; feat/gateway-fail-open and feat/gateway-entry then land under the same 0.4.0.
